title: Benchmark Everything Everywhere All at Once
abstract: arXiv:2606.06462v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Benchmarks provide standardized measures for evaluating and advancing large language models (LLMs) and multimodal LLMs (MLLMs). As models improve, existing benchmarks can approach saturation, making it harder to challenge models and distinguish among them. While reusing annotated datasets can reduce data collection and labeling effort, constructing new benchmarks remains labor-intensive, and existing agent-based approaches often target specific tasks or automate only parts of the process. To address these challenges, we introduce BenchHarness, an autonomous harness for end-to-end benchmark customization. It coordinates multiple agents and tools to analyze user requirements, search for suitable datasets, and construct validated benchmarks, with support for refinement based on model performance. translated_title: 瞬息全宇宙：一站式基准测试构建
translated_abstract: 基准测试为评估和推动大语言模型（LLM）及多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的发展提供了标准化手段。随着模型能力的提升，现有基准测试可能逐渐趋于饱和，使得挑战模型能力、区分模型优劣变得更加困难。虽然复用已标注的数据集可以减少数据收集和标注的工作量，但构建新的基准测试仍然十分耗费人力，且现有的基于智能体的方法往往只针对特定任务，或仅能自动化流程的一部分。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了BenchHarness——一个用于端到端基准测试定制的自主框架。它协调多个智能体和工具来分析用户需求、搜索合适的数据集并构建经过验证的基准测试，同时支持基于模型性能的进一步优化。为了评估BenchHarness，我们构建了涵盖多种任务和模态的16个基准测试。人工评审和以大模型为裁判的评估表……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 本文提出BenchHarness，一个端到端的自主基准测试定制框架，通过协调多个智能体与工具来分析需求、检索数据集并构建经人工与LLM评审验证的基准测试，自动化地构建了覆盖多样任务与模态的16个基准。
en_tdlr: BenchHarness is an autonomous end-to-end harness for benchmark customization that coordinates multiple agents and tools to analyze user requirements, search suitable datasets, and construct validated benchmarks, demonstrated by building 16 benchmarks across diverse tasks and modalities.
